The prototype has no server/main.lua (no exports, no manifest). tests/compat/txhost.lua is the
test stand-in for that wiring; it is NOT the coordinator's real runtime wiring.

To run the suite against another copy (for example the finalized wave-1 coordinator), set
OP77_TX_DIR to its resources/system/open77_transactions folder. Do not edit these files: refresh
them from the origin instead, and update the blob ids above.
